metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by midudev: After, a prompt queue; Use Haiku and Think Hard, prompt prefixes for one turn; Token Meter, Sub Meter and Context Meter, tokens, subscription and context window usage at a glance; Image Preview, hover a pasted image to see it; Time Machine, a git snapshot of every turn to go back to; Commit, Conventional Commits and a push on Haiku; Narrator, Claude tells you out loud what it did

plugins.name: after
plugins.description: Queue prompts to run after the current task, without steering it.

plugins.name: use-haiku
plugins.description: Start a prompt with _ to run that turn on Haiku, shown as you type, while it runs and under the answer.

plugins.name: think-hard
plugins.description: Start a prompt with + and that turn thinks at max effort.

plugins.name: token-meter
plugins.description: Each turn's tokens and the session total, in color under the prompt.

plugins.name: sub-meter
plugins.description: Subscription usage at the bottom right: the 5-hour and weekly windows, taking turns, side by side or fixed on one of them.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: The session's context window fill right above the prompt: gray, then yellow when it is time to /compact, red when a new session is better.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Hover a pasted [Image #N] to see the picture: above the prompt while you write, and on the prompts you sent.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: /commit asks commit + push, commit only or a new branch, then splits your changes into Conventional Commits on Haiku 5.5.

plugins.name: narrator
plugins.description: Click ⏸︎ narrator off in the footer, or /narrator, and after each turn Claude tells you out loud what it did, in your language, with the best free voice your system has.

plugins.name: time-machine
plugins.description: Every turn that changes files is a git snapshot: /timeline puts the working tree back as before any turn, Bash changes included. Undoable.
